daylight-electrician.headline: Electrical help, from faults to fittings.
about: Daylight Electrician Singapore handles electrical repairs and installations for homes and commercial properties. Its published services include power-trip troubleshooting, wiring, lighting, ceiling fans and power points.

The company lists a Lower Delta Road office and a west branch at Bukit Batok Crescent. Enquiries are handled by phone or WhatsApp; its contact page lists daily hours from 8am to 10pm. The offices do not accept walk-ins.

services.name: Power trips & fault finding
services.description: Troubleshooting for power failures, recurring trips and other electrical faults.

services.name: Lighting & fan installation
services.description: Installation and replacement of lights, switches and ceiling fans.

services.name: Sockets, wiring & distribution boards
services.description: Power points, rewiring and distribution-board work are listed in its service range.

mr-plumber.headline: Plumbing repairs, replacements and urgent call-outs.
about: Mr Plumber Singapore lists plumbing repairs and installations for homes and businesses. Its service range covers choked sinks and toilets, leaking pipes, water heaters and replacement fittings.

The company publishes 24-hour availability, seven days a week. It takes enquiries by phone and WhatsApp, with a main office on Lower Delta Road and a separate Paya Lebar desk. There is no showroom or walk-in service.

services.name: Chokes & blocked drains
services.description: Clearing blocked sinks, toilet bowls, floor traps and drainage pipes.

services.name: Leaks & pipe repairs
services.description: Finding and repairing leaks in water pipes, sinks and toilet fittings.

services.name: Fixtures & water heaters
services.description: Installation or replacement of taps, basins, toilets, pipes and water heaters.

lion-city-aircon.headline: Clear aircon prices before the visit.
about: Lion City Air Conditioner Services publishes a detailed rate card for general servicing, chemical cleaning, overhauls and yearly contracts. The listed prices include GST, making it easier to compare the cost for the number of units in your home.

Its published address is on Serangoon North Avenue 4. Phone and WhatsApp use the same contact number. The profile includes dated customer excerpts, including comments about cleaning work and the experience with named technicians.

services.name: General aircon servicing
services.description: A published rate for one unit, plus multi-unit prices and yearly contracts.

services.name: Chemical wash
services.description: A per-unit chemical-wash price is listed separately from an overhaul.

services.name: Chemical overhaul & packages
services.description: Overhaul and yearly-contract options include gas according to the published service notes.

338-aircon.headline: Routine servicing and contract options.
about: 338 Aircon publishes one-time servicing and maintenance-contract options through its online booking page. The rate on that page starts at S$55 for one unit, with separate contracts that include or exclude gas.

The company lists its address on Duku Road. Its installation pages also describe chemical-wash work, although a per-unit chemical-wash rate was not captured. Confirm the package, the number of units and the contact number before booking.

services.name: General servicing
services.description: One-unit servicing and a published starting price on the booking page.

services.name: Maintenance contracts
services.description: Separate contract options are listed with and without free gas.

services.name: Chemical cleaning
services.description: Chemical-wash work is described on the installation pages. Ask for a job-specific price.

socool.headline: An aircon company to compare for routine servicing.
about: SoCool is an air-conditioning service company with a published address at Midview City on Sin Ming Lane. Roster includes it for routine servicing enquiries and its public review history.

The review mirrors show the same score but different totals. A company rate card was not captured for this profile, so contact the business for a written price and the exact work included before arranging a visit.

services.name: Routine aircon servicing
services.description: Discuss the number of indoor units, your service history and the work included in the visit.

billy-aircon.headline: Chemical cleaning for wall units and cassettes.
about: Billy Aircon publishes separate chemical-cleaning ranges for wall-mounted units and ceiling cassettes. Its rate card distinguishes a non-dismantle chemical wash from a full overhaul, so the quoted service can be compared like for like.

Its musty-smell page lists Monday to Saturday hours of 9am to 6pm and says there is no call-out fee. GST treatment is not stated on the captured chemical-wash page, and a street address has not been added to this profile.

services.name: Wall-unit chemical wash
services.description: A non-dismantle wash, with a published range for a wall-mounted unit.

services.name: Cassette chemical wash
services.description: A separate published range for ceiling cassette units.

services.name: Full chemical overhaul
services.description: Wall-unit and cassette overhauls are priced separately from a standard chemical wash.

cool-aircon.headline: A detailed rate card for cleaning and troubleshooting.
about: Cool Aircon publishes prices for general servicing, chemical washing, overhauls and refrigerant top-ups. Its pricing page separates the costs by unit count, aircon size, refrigerant type and measured pressure where relevant.

The business lists a Bukit Batok Street 11 address and daily hours of 8am to 10pm, including weekends and public holidays. It says it is not GST-registered and does not add GST to the published prices.

services.name: General servicing
services.description: One-time servicing rates are listed for one to six indoor units.

services.name: Chemical wash & overhaul
services.description: Separate tables cover washing, wall-unit overhauls and different aircon sizes.

services.name: Gas & troubleshooting
services.description: Gas pricing depends on refrigerant and measured PSI. Troubleshooting has a separate fee.

cool-earth.headline: Chemical cleaning with published price ranges.
about: Cool Earth Aircon publishes chemical-wash and overhaul services alongside general servicing, leak repair and troubleshooting. Its chemical-wash page lists an office address at Block 108 on Simei Street 1.

The same page gives different starting prices and ranges for some jobs. Use the figures below as a starting point, then confirm which service, unit type and scope the quote includes. The company also states a 90-day workmanship warranty.

services.name: Chemical wash & overhaul
services.description: Cleaning options with published starting prices and ranges that need confirmation.

services.name: General servicing
services.description: Single and multi-unit servicing offers appear on the company page.

services.name: Leak repair & diagnosis
services.description: Leak repair and not-cold troubleshooting are listed separately from a gas top-up.

cool-earth.mapNote: The map marks Block 108 Simei Street 1. Google Maps shows a different postal code from the company website; confirm the location before visiting.

direct-plumber.headline: Published ranges for blocked sinks and drains.
about: Direct Plumber publishes job-specific ranges for sink, floor-trap and toilet chokes, along with drain jetting. That makes this profile useful when you want an initial price range before discussing a blockage.

Its website footer names Reliable Home Services Pte. Ltd. and gives an address at Ghim Moh Link. The site also prints PUB and BCA identifiers. Those remain company-published details; the registers have not been checked for this profile.

services.name: Sink & floor-trap chokes
services.description: Both services have a published range of S$60 to S$150.

services.name: Toilet chokes
services.description: The company lists S$80 to S$180 for a toilet choke.

services.name: Drain jetting
services.description: A published S$150 to S$400 range for drain-jetting work.

direct-plumber.mapNote: The map marks the published Ghim Moh Link address. The company website also embeds a Duku Lane map; confirm the location before visiting.

kiasu-plumber.headline: Starting prices for common plumbing jobs.
about: Kiasu Plumber lists starting prices for common jobs such as sink and toilet chokes, copper-pipe work, leak detection and basin installation. The rates are described as onwards prices, so the final cost depends on the work agreed.

The company describes itself as family-owned since 1998 and advertises 24/7 service. A street address, licence number and sourced review count were not captured on the homepage, so confirm these details directly if they matter for your booking.

services.name: Chokes & blockages
services.description: Starting prices for kitchen-sink and toilet-bowl chokes.

services.name: Pipes & leak detection
services.description: Copper-pipe repair and supply, plus concealed-leak detection.

services.name: Basins, traps & fittings
services.description: Installation or replacement options for basins, bottle traps, taps and hoses.

repair-sg.headline: Electrical repairs with a direct enquiry line.
about: Repair.sg lists electrical services through a dedicated electrician page. Phone and WhatsApp use the same number, and a separate isolator-switch page gives a starting price for installing a new double-pole isolator.

The captured electrician page does not include a complete rate card or street address. Ask for a quote covering the job, transport and parts. Its handyman page lists Monday to Saturday hours of 8am to 7pm, with enquiries answered outside those hours when possible.

services.name: Electrical repair enquiries
services.description: Describe the fault and send photos to confirm whether the team handles your job.

services.name: Isolator replacement
services.description: Replacement with a new double-pole isolator is listed from S$120, before transport.

sk-electrical.headline: Electrical enquiries with a sourced Maps listing.
about: SK Electrical is listed at Yishun Avenue 4, with a phone number and 24-hour hours on the Google Maps listing checked for this profile. Its rating here comes directly from that listing.

A detailed service menu, published price list and dated review excerpts were not captured. Contact the company with your job details to confirm its scope, availability, call-out charge and the total cost before a visit.

services.name: Electrical service enquiries
services.description: Call with the fault or installation you need and confirm whether the company can take the job.

1st-electrical.headline: Power-trip repair and electrical installations.
about: 1st Electrical Services lists power-trip troubleshooting, urgent electrical repairs and power-point installation. Its website also describes lighting, switches, wiring and distribution-board work for residential and commercial properties.

The published office address is at Carros Centre on Jalan Lam Huat. The business advertises 24/7 emergency availability. A complete rate card was not captured, so confirm call-out, diagnostic and repair charges before arranging the visit.

services.name: Power trips & emergency repairs
services.description: Troubleshooting for power failures and urgent electrical faults.

services.name: Power points & switches
services.description: Installation or replacement of sockets, light switches and heater switches.

services.name: Wiring & lighting
services.description: Wiring, rewiring and lighting work are included in the published service range.

sg-handyman-engineering.headline: Help with repairs across several trades.
about: SG Handyman Engineering lists plumbing, electrical work, painting, flooring and carpentry. Its website describes jobs for HDB flats, condos and landed homes, from leaking pipes to cabinet and door repairs.

The business publishes a North Bridge Road address and 24/7 hours. Its contact page includes a UEN and more than one phone number. Confirm the scope, written price and any licence needed for the actual work before booking.

services.name: Plumbing repairs
services.description: Drain cleaning, tap replacement, chokes and leak repairs are listed.

services.name: Carpentry & home repairs
services.description: Door, hinge, cabinet and shelving work are described on the website.

services.name: Painting & flooring
services.description: Painting, floor repairs and flooring installation appear in its service menu.

isoteam-homecare.headline: A homecare company with a registry record.
about: ISOTeam Homecare appears in a registry mirror as ISOTEAM HOMECARE PTE. LTD., with UEN 201935675D. The record lists an address at the ISOTeam Building on Changi North Street 1 and the phone number shown on this page.

The current profile is a starting point for a homecare or handyman enquiry. A detailed service menu, price list and dated reviews were not captured. Ask the company to confirm the work it takes on and provide a written quote.

services.name: Homecare & handyman enquiries
services.description: Explain the repair or maintenance work you need. The specific service scope needs direct confirmation.

sureclean.headline: Home cleaning with a direct company contact.
about: Sureclean is listed for weekly and one-time home-cleaning enquiries. Its company pages publish a Bukit Batok Crescent address, contact numbers and registration details, and this profile includes dated customer excerpts from a Google reviews page.

The weekly page advertises an offer from S$22 but does not specify the time unit, inclusions or GST. Confirm the property size, cleaning duration, tasks and total charge before booking. Published contact and weekly-page hours differ.

services.name: Weekly home cleaning
services.description: Recurring cleaning enquiries with a published weekly offer that needs scope and duration confirmation.

services.name: First-session trial
services.description: The weekly page also advertises a trial heading with the same starting offer.

services.name: One-time home cleaning
services.description: Ask for a quote matched to the property size, condition and cleaning tasks.
